angles.notes: Angle summary — RoaR/RR.GG era decoded: RoaR Gaming was RiveR's attempt to pivot the community into a CS:GO esports org. Rebrand announced Oct 15 2017 (exact date recovered); by Mar 2018 they had a RoaR.GG website on Esportsify (roaresports.com / roargg.esportsify.com), RR.GG-branded 10-Mans, a retake server, a 5-man CS:GO roster (Skye-, staff, flame, cheesyace, daltoid), a 4-person staff (RiveR, Maximus, psych, flame), recruiting via Steam/Discord/Guilded, and ambitions for Overwatch, Rocket League, Fortnite and R6S sections. It fizzled fast: the site's forum never passed 4 threads, and the site was dead by Jul 2019. New officer-level names for the yearbook: Flame-/flame, Holdie, Maximus, psych, plus 2020-era officer Patches. The 2020 revival is now fully documented: Bannerlord Discord call by Patches Mar 28 2020 → 2nd Coldstream Guard group founded Apr 7 2020 (owner RiveR, officer Patches, 101 members, roster saved) → ~18 NW public linebattles Apr 15–Jul 8 2020 → Coldstream Gaming group founded Nov 21 2020 (tag CSG.GG, 28 members, roster saved). dead_ends: FSE forum's own search engine (action=search2) is CAPTCHA-gated for guests - not bypassed per ground rules; worked around via Show Posts profile crawls, which proved far more complete than Google's thin indexing of fsegames.eu.

No FSE forum accounts exist for officers 'dominos man', 'Timmy9000', 'Blaboon', or 'NoxV DaviD' (memberlist search + Google both empty). 'Capitulated Magik' is plausibly FSE user Magik27 (u=561), but his only two posts (Nov 2012) are inside already-scraped topic 443 - nothing new.

No FSE trace of the 21stPA Public Linebattle Group (Apr 2011) or the original 'Midnight Mercenarys' (Jun 2011) eras - the fsegames.eu forum postdates them; the only Midnight Mercenaries reference on FSE is retrospective (RivenX's Jan 2015 admin app calling MidnightMercs 'the old 2ndCS community').

'NoxV' / Nox Viator footprint on FSE is minimal: the topic 443 rename (already scraped), RivenX's Feb 2014 tournament posts, and 'NoxV Nutslapper' - no separate Nox Viator thread found; NA Duel League S2 and 4v4/3v3 tournament thread first pages contain no NoxV rosters.

No RoaR Gaming / RR.GG presence on fsegames.eu at all (2017-2019 was spent off-forum); the 2019 silent year on FSE is empty except the Nov 5, 2019 founding post of the 13th Virginia Infantry on the BCoF board.
The second Royal Army thread (topic 9024, Sept 2013 - Nov 2013) never lists or mentions the Coldstream - confirming departure, but yielding no exit statement.
Wayback CDX was not needed: fsegames.eu is live and every target page fetched directly; SMF URLs (index.php?topic=N) carry no names, so CDX URL filtering offers no additional discovery.
Desparin's '2nd Coldstream Skirmisher detachment under Peter' memory (topic 426) initially looked like a club roster crumb but resolves to the unrelated EU 2ndCSG - excluded from club findings.

Nov 2019) on the Battle Cry of Freedom board. ## 3. CONTRADICTIONS WITH THE KNOWN TIMELINE

1. **The 2ndCS did not start as a Napoleonic Wars regiment.** It was founded (Jan 11–19, 2012) as the **Mount & Musket** division of Midnight Mercs and switched to NW only after the DLC launched (Apr–Jun 2012) — taleworlds 212200 archive + midnightmercs enlistment form archive.
2. **Founding-date tension:** Crawford claimed on Nov 15, 2012 he'd been "running the NA 2nd Coldstream Regiment of Footguards for about a year now" (implying late 2011, before the brief's Jan 2012) — fsegames topic 671 via u=557 post history. The community itself officially dates its founding to **June 28, 2011** and ignores the 21stPA era entirely — steamcommunity.com/groups/NoxViator (About).
3. **The eras were not cleanly sequential.** The "2nd Coldstream" identity persisted and was actively revived *inside* the Nox Viator era: a mid-2013 reactivation ("The 2ndCS is back!", Jul 31, 2013 — youtube.com/watch?v=wJaeXAH_Prs) and a full Mar–Sep 2015 revival with its own chain of command (coldstream.enjin.com archives). The brief's "2nd Coldstream Guard (Apr 2020)" was the *second* revival, not the first.
4. **2019 was not fully silent** — the community founded the 13th Virginia Infantry on Nov 5, 2019 with Lt. River as an officer (fsegames topic 42952), and a "2ndCS" fought a Battle Grounds III linebattle Jul 20, 2019 (identity unconfirmed — youtube.com/watch?v=_dPeUXaSG8Q).
5. **Minor date nuance:** the RoaR rebrand posted Oct 15, 2017 6:37pm local (feed shows Oct 16 UTC) — steamcommunity.com/groups/NoxViator/announcements.
6. **Disambiguation hazard (not a contradiction but merge-poison):** at least four unrelated "2nd Coldstream" regiments coexisted — Spartan's EU regiment (tag 2nd_Coldstream_, 2ndcoldstreamreg.enjin.com / 2ndcoldstream.enjin.com; an admin ruling split the name by timezone — taleworlds 234617 archive), the EU 2ndCSG (fsegames topic 207), Hendrik's German M&M revival (/groups/2ndColdstreamMM), and a 2013 "/groups/2ndcsg" group of uncertain relation. Do not merge their rosters/videos.
